title.zh: 巴西加密交易所赶在央行授权截止日前申请牌照
title.en: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline

current_state.zh: 巴西加密货币交易所须在周五前向巴西中央银行申请授权，高昂的资本、合规和审计要求以及尚未明确的监管问题，使在该国 2025 年 11 月虚拟资产框架下获得持牌运营的道路更加复杂。
current_state.en: Brazilian crypto exchanges face a Friday deadline to apply for authorization with the Banco Central do Brasil, with steep capital, compliance and audit requirements and open regulatory questions complicating the path to licensed operation under the country's November 2025 virtual-asset framework.

updates.title_zh: 币安在周五截止日期前申请巴西加密牌照
updates.title_en: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安在 10 月 30 日监管截止日期前向巴西中央银行申请加密服务提供商牌照，同时针对巴西用户限制借贷、保证金交易并下架 22 种资产。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance applied to the Central Bank of Brazil for a crypto service provider license ahead of the Oct. 30 regulatory deadline while restricting lending, margin trading and delisting 22 assets for Brazilian users.

updates.current_state_en: Binance applied to the Central Bank of Brazil for a crypto service provider license ahead of the Oct. 30 regulatory deadline while restricting lending, margin trading and delisting 22 assets for Brazilian users.

updates.title_zh: 【巴西私人银行 Itaú Unibanco 向巴西央行通报其加密交易和托管业务】
updates.title_en: 【巴西私人银行 Itaú Unibanco 向巴西央行通报其加密交易和托管业务】
updates.what_changed_zh: Itaú Unibanco 已通知巴西央行，将在央行的授权框架下提供包括比特币、以太坊和 USDC 在内的 15 种资产的加密交易和托管服务。
updates.what_changed_en: Itaú Unibanco has notified Brazil's central bank that it will offer crypto trading and custody for 15 assets, including bitcoin, ether, and USDC, under the central bank's authorization framework.
updates.current_state_zh: Itaú Unibanco 已通知巴西央行，将在央行的授权框架下提供包括比特币、以太坊和 USDC 在内的 15 种资产的加密交易和托管服务。

updates.title_zh: 巴西最大私人银行 Itaú Unibanco 成为该国首家通知监管机构的银行
updates.title_en: Brazil’s Largest Private Bank Itaú Unibanco Becomes Country’s First to Notify Re
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道确认 Itaú Unibanco 于10月27日向巴西央行通报加密交易和托管业务，并称其是巴西首家在新数字资产规则下完成通报的银行，截止日期为10月30日。
updates.what_changed_en: The report confirms Itaú Unibanco notified Brazil's central bank on October 27 and identifies it as the first Brazilian bank to do so under the new digital-asset rules, ahead of the October 30 deadline.
updates.current_state_zh: Itaú Unibanco 已向巴西央行通报其加密交易和托管业务，成为新数字资产规则下首家完成通报的巴西银行；其支持15种加密资产，现有运营者的通报或申请截止日期为10月30日。
updates.current_state_en: Itaú Unibanco has notified Brazil's central bank of its crypto trading and custody operations, becoming the first Brazilian bank to do so under the new digital-asset rules; it supports 15 cryptoassets, with existing operators facing an October 30 deadline for notifications or applications.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Itaú Unibanco became the first Brazilian bank to notify the central bank of its crypto trading and custody operations under the country's new digital-asset rules, ahead of the October 30 deadline for existing operators.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Itaú Unibanco became the first Brazilian bank to notify the central bank of its crypto trading and custody operations under the country's new digital-asset rules, ahead of the October 30 deadline for existing operators.
